title: Barbie: Super Model - Rollerskating at the Beach
description:
A very strange (and sort of broken) song from a Barbie game for the SNES. Despite this, it has an inexplicable charm to it.

Due to its short length, it's probably best suited for things like title screens and overworlds, probably for less serious hacks.
